name: cc-parse-stmt-fwd
interface_notes: The binding stores a Forth execution token; it does not emit a C call or create a target function pointer.
state_owner: Statement parser family; installed once after all bodies are defined
semantic_purpose: Provide the deferred builder call target that closes mutual recursion between dispatcher and body parsers.
teaching_section: Reference: statement boundaries and recursive branches

name: cc-parse-compound
interface_notes: Scope pop does not reclaim arena objects or lower the function slot counter. The loop has no separate EOF recovery branch.
state_owner: Current block owns a symbol-count scope marker
semantic_purpose: With opening brace already consumed, read/replay each body token through the deferred dispatcher until the closing brace is consumed, then restore symbol visibility.
teaching_section: A compound owns its closing brace

name: cc-parse-if
interface_notes: Inner recursive if parsing gets the first opportunity to consume else; saved fields are builder-stack values.
state_owner: This if owns its JZ field and any later end-JMP field across recursive body calls
semantic_purpose: Emit condition/test/JZ; parse the then-body; commit an else by inserting and patching two edges, or put back the next token and patch the single exit.
teaching_section: Reference: both if completion paths

name: cc-emit-jmp-vaddr
interface_notes: The target argument is absolute; the emitted instruction remains relative. Total width is five bytes; fitting rel32 is an assumption.
state_owner: Emitter consumes one known target virtual address
semantic_purpose: Append E9 and a four-byte field equal to target minus the virtual address just after the field.
teaching_section: A known destination still becomes a relative instruction

name: cc-emit-jnz-vaddr
interface_notes: Total width is six bytes. The do/while consumer supplies its body-top address after testing the condition.
state_owner: Emitter consumes one known target virtual address
semantic_purpose: Append 0F 85 and a four-byte field equal to target minus the virtual address just after the field.
teaching_section: A known destination still becomes a relative instruction

name: cc-emit-je-vaddr
interface_notes: A six-byte equality branch selects a body after its comparison; reverse selector order does not reverse source-order fall-through.
state_owner: Switch dispatch consumes a recorded case-body virtual address
semantic_purpose: Append 0F 84 and the four-byte displacement from field end to the known body address.
teaching_section: Work a complete switch layout

name: cc-break-stack-head
interface_notes: Loops and switches save/replace/restore this cell; nodes belong to the arena, not the generated stack.
state_owner: Innermost loop or switch temporarily owns the active break head
semantic_purpose: Store the builder pointer to a two-cell list of unfinished break rel32 fields; zero means no node.
teaching_section: Give each enclosing construct its own lists

name: cc-continue-stack-head
interface_notes: Loops save/replace/restore it; switches retain it so continue still reaches the enclosing loop.
state_owner: Innermost loop temporarily owns the active continue head
semantic_purpose: Store the builder pointer to unfinished continue rel32 fields.
teaching_section: Give each enclosing construct its own lists

name: cc-fixup-target-tmp
interface_notes: The walkers do not recursively invoke one another; the scratch cell is not per-node storage.
state_owner: One nonrecursive generic patch walk borrows shared builder scratch
semantic_purpose: Hold the destination virtual address while traversing a rel32 or imm64 fixup list.
teaching_section: Give each enclosing construct its own lists

name: cc-for-top-vaddr
interface_notes: All four cells are saved before initialization and restored after list restoration and scope pop; the lexer mark contains none of them.
state_owner: Current for owns one scratch tuple; nested for saves and restores the outer tuple
semantic_purpose: Retain the current for condition-top target address while its body and step are emitted.
teaching_section: Keep the outer for's state

name: cc-for-end-fixup
interface_notes: All four cells are saved before initialization and restored after list restoration and scope pop; the lexer mark contains none of them.
state_owner: Current for owns one scratch tuple; nested for saves and restores the outer tuple
semantic_purpose: Retain the current for condition-JZ field offset until the back edge has been emitted.
teaching_section: Keep the outer for's state

name: cc-for-step-start
interface_notes: All four cells are saved before initialization and restored after list restoration and scope pop; the lexer mark contains none of them.
state_owner: Current for owns one scratch tuple; nested for saves and restores the outer tuple
semantic_purpose: Retain the inclusive source-byte offset at which the step replay window begins.
teaching_section: Keep the outer for's state

name: cc-for-step-end
interface_notes: All four cells are saved before initialization and restored after list restoration and scope pop; the lexer mark contains none of them.
state_owner: Current for owns one scratch tuple; nested for saves and restores the outer tuple
semantic_purpose: Retain the exclusive replay boundary at the matching header close parenthesis, computed as source position minus one.
teaching_section: Keep the outer for's state

name: cc-add-break-fixup
interface_notes: Calls cc-add-fixup-to-list with cc-break-stack-head; the helper does not choose the eventual destination.
state_owner: Active enclosing break owner; generic node allocator receives the head-cell address
semantic_purpose: Prepend a supplied output field offset to the active break list.
teaching_section: Give each enclosing construct its own lists

name: cc-add-continue-fixup
interface_notes: Calls cc-add-fixup-to-list with cc-continue-stack-head; while, for and do supply different destinations.
state_owner: Active enclosing loop; generic node allocator receives the head-cell address
semantic_purpose: Prepend a supplied output field offset to the active continue list.
teaching_section: Give each enclosing construct its own lists

name: cc-walk-and-patch-to-vaddr
interface_notes: Does not clear the owner head or free nodes. C10 opens the complete walker; C16 retrieves it for loop-owned lists.
state_owner: Caller owns the head; generic walker owns only traversal and shared target scratch
semantic_purpose: Walk 16-byte {field-offset,next} nodes and patch each four-byte field with target-(base+offset+4).
teaching_section: Give each enclosing construct its own lists

name: cc-walk-and-patch-imm64-to-vaddr
interface_notes: Not a branch-displacement walker and not a native goto-node walker. C10 opens the full body; C18 and C19 use it for function addresses.
state_owner: Function-symbol owner supplies a two-cell address-fixup list
semantic_purpose: Walk {field-offset,next} nodes and overwrite each eight-byte immediate with the absolute target address.
teaching_section: Give each enclosing construct its own lists

name: cc-walk-and-patch-fixups
interface_notes: Does not itself clear a head cell; callers restore or clear their ownership state separately.
state_owner: Enclosing construct knows the destination when it invokes this adapter
semantic_purpose: Read the current output virtual address and delegate the supplied list head to the generic rel32 walker.
teaching_section: Give each enclosing construct its own lists

name: cc-parse-while
interface_notes: Body parsing preserves the saved top and exit field on builder stacks; condition evaluation, not merely its TEST, is the continue destination.
state_owner: Current loop owns break/continue heads and loop-entry switch-depth snapshot
semantic_purpose: Save outer state, record condition top, emit condition/JZ and body, patch continues to condition top, emit back JMP, patch condition/break exits after it, then restore outer state.
teaching_section: Read the complete while body

name: cc-parse-for
interface_notes: Restores all eight lexer cells plus separately saved source length, not output or arena allocations; it does not install the original step line number for replay diagnostics.
state_owner: Current for owns scope, four scratch cells, two jump-list heads and loop switch-depth; replay owns a fresh lexer mark
semantic_purpose: Emit init and condition, capture the step token interval, emit body, patch continues to step start, replay step under a temporary source limit, restore reader state, emit back edge and complete exits.
teaching_section: A for separates source order from execution order

name: cc-parse-do-while
interface_notes: No initial condition-JZ exists; continue must not bypass the test by targeting the body top.
state_owner: Current loop owns two heads and loop-entry switch-depth snapshot
semantic_purpose: Record body top, parse body, patch continues to condition start, consume while(expression);, emit test/JNZ to body top, patch breaks after JNZ and restore outer state.
teaching_section: Read the complete do closure

name: cc-switch-cases-head
interface_notes: This is neither a generic 16-byte jump list nor a native goto list.
state_owner: Innermost switch saves/replaces/restores the outer head
semantic_purpose: Store the head of 24-byte {constant,body-vaddr,next} builder records, prepended in reverse source order.
teaching_section: Source detail: case-node storage and traversal

name: cc-switch-default-vaddr
interface_notes: A later default overwrites this cell; no duplicate-default rejection is introduced by this storage.
state_owner: Innermost switch saves/replaces/restores the outer default target
semantic_purpose: Hold the current default body address, with zero denoting no default recorded.
teaching_section: Reading case and default labels

name: cc-switch-type
interface_notes: The effective integer-use/type providers are profile-dependent; storing a type is not itself complete C switch validation.
state_owner: Innermost switch saves/restores the outer promoted controlling type
semantic_purpose: Retain cc-unary-type of the expression type for LP64 case conversion.
teaching_section: Native detail: convert before choosing comparison width

name: cc-add-switch-case
interface_notes: Does not emit target instructions or diagnose duplicate case constants; distinct-case examples are an explicit premise.
state_owner: Current switch owns the active case head; arena owns allocated records
semantic_purpose: Allocate 24 bytes, store K at +0 and body virtual address at +8, link old head at +16, then install the new head.
teaching_section: Source detail: case-node storage and traversal

name: cc-switch-label
interface_notes: Legacy is an identity operation. Conversion precedes choosing compare width.
state_owner: Current switch type selects conversion; helper consumes and returns the constant
semantic_purpose: Under LP64 and a four-byte controlling type, mask to 32 bits and sign-extend when signed; otherwise leave K unchanged.
teaching_section: Native detail: convert before choosing comparison width

name: cc-switch-case
interface_notes: Constant evaluation is builder work. This helper records a label but emits no body instruction.
state_owner: Current switch owns the new body-address record
semantic_purpose: Compute the constant now, apply the profile conversion, require a colon (error 170 otherwise), and record the current output virtual address.
teaching_section: Reading case and default labels

name: cc-switch-default
interface_notes: Does not allocate a case node or diagnose a previously stored default.
state_owner: Current switch owns the separate default cell
semantic_purpose: Consume the required colon and store current output virtual address as default.
teaching_section: Reading case and default labels

name: cc-emit-switch-compare
interface_notes: Short compare plus JE occupies 13 bytes; full-width compare plus JE occupies 19. The width choice follows conversion.
state_owner: Selector emitter consumes one converted K; RDI is available as target scratch during dispatch
semantic_purpose: Legacy emits CMP RBX,imm32; LP64 uses MOVABS RDI,K plus CMP RBX,RDI for constants outside signed-32 range.
teaching_section: Native detail: convert before choosing comparison width

name: cc-emit-switch-dispatch
interface_notes: The newest-first comparison chain does not rearrange body bytes, clear the head or free nodes.
state_owner: Current switch owns case records; emitter borrows the traversal cursor
semantic_purpose: Walk node+16 links; for each node emit comparison with node+0 and JE to the body address at node+8.
teaching_section: Source detail: case-node storage and traversal

name: cc-parse-switch
interface_notes: Direct switch braces push/pop symbol scope only under LP64. Legacy body entry bypasses instructions before the selected case. It requires a brace body and has no separate EOF recovery branch.
state_owner: Current switch owns case/default/break/type state and one lexical saved-RBX obligation; surrounding loop keeps continue ownership
semantic_purpose: Emit expression/save/initial jump, compile brace-delimited bodies while recording labels, append body-end jump, emit selector, patch exits to one POP RBX, then restore outer state.
teaching_section: Parser detail: how the switch is assembled

name: cc-parse-break-stmt
interface_notes: No switch pop is emitted here: a switch break reaches its cleanup POP. This adapter has no independent validity-depth check.
state_owner: Active enclosing loop or switch owns the destination and later cleanup
semantic_purpose: Require semicolon, emit a JMP placeholder, and append its field to the active break list.
teaching_section: Break and continue consume syntax before adding work

name: cc-parse-continue-stmt
interface_notes: The list owner determines condition versus step destination. Emitting unwind does not change lexical switch depth.
state_owner: Current loop owns the continue head and saved switch-entry depth
semantic_purpose: Require semicolon, emit switch-depth minus loop-entry-depth RBX pops, then record an unfinished continue JMP.
teaching_section: When a switch lies inside the loop

name: cc-label-default-cap
interface_notes: A common selected limit must agree with all five selected bases.
state_owner: Default label workspace capacity
semantic_purpose: Define the default maximum of 64 entries for each of five eight-byte-cell arrays.
teaching_section: Reference: selected label storage

name: cc-label-limit
interface_notes: Selectors replace the limit and all bases together, without migrating active rows.
state_owner: Workspace selector owns capacity; function parser owns active count
semantic_purpose: Store the currently selected label-entry limit, initially 64.
teaching_section: Reference: selected label storage

name: cc-label-default-cap cc-label-limit !
interface_notes: This load-time store does not initialize live rows or enable native goto handling.
state_owner: Source-loading initialization selects default label capacity
semantic_purpose: Store 64 into the selected label limit.
teaching_section: Reference: selected label storage

name: cc-label-cap
interface_notes: The accessor returns entries, not bytes; cc-label-create checks count+1 before storing a row.
state_owner: Selected label workspace
semantic_purpose: Read cc-label-limit for the capacity check.
teaching_section: Reference: selected label storage

name: cc-label-default-name-addr
interface_notes: Borrowed name bytes remain in the retained source buffer. The selected-base cell can point elsewhere.
state_owner: Static default label workspace
semantic_purpose: Reserve 64 eight-byte cells for each label's source-name address.
teaching_section: Reference: selected label storage

name: cc-label-name-addr-buffer
interface_notes: Borrowed name bytes remain in the retained source buffer. Initialization selects the default array; direct selection replaces the base.
state_owner: Workspace selector owns this mutable base pointer
semantic_purpose: Hold the current base address of the label source-name address column.
teaching_section: Reference: selected label storage

name: cc-label-default-name-addr cc-label-name-addr-buffer !
interface_notes: Selects builder storage; it does not emit a target store, reset label count or fill every array cell.
state_owner: Source-loading initialization selects one default column
semantic_purpose: Install the static default name-addr array address in its selected-base cell.
teaching_section: Reference: selected label storage

name: cc-label-name-addr
interface_notes: Borrowed name bytes remain in the retained source buffer. Row operations apply cell[] afterward.
state_owner: Clients borrow the currently selected column base
semantic_purpose: Read and return the selected base pointer for the label source-name address array.
teaching_section: Reference: selected label storage

name: cc-label-default-name-len
interface_notes: Names are compared by explicit address and length, without requiring a copied terminator. The selected-base cell can point elsewhere.
state_owner: Static default label workspace
semantic_purpose: Reserve 64 eight-byte cells for each label's source-name byte length.
teaching_section: Reference: selected label storage

name: cc-label-name-len-buffer
interface_notes: Names are compared by explicit address and length, without requiring a copied terminator. Initialization selects the default array; direct selection replaces the base.
state_owner: Workspace selector owns this mutable base pointer
semantic_purpose: Hold the current base address of the label source-name byte length column.
teaching_section: Reference: selected label storage

name: cc-label-default-name-len cc-label-name-len-buffer !
interface_notes: Selects builder storage; it does not emit a target store, reset label count or fill every array cell.
state_owner: Source-loading initialization selects one default column
semantic_purpose: Install the static default name-len array address in its selected-base cell.
teaching_section: Reference: selected label storage

name: cc-label-name-len
interface_notes: Names are compared by explicit address and length, without requiring a copied terminator. Row operations apply cell[] afterward.
state_owner: Clients borrow the currently selected column base
semantic_purpose: Read and return the selected base pointer for the label source-name byte length array.
teaching_section: Reference: selected label storage

name: cc-label-default-vaddr
interface_notes: Zero denotes an undefined label. The selected-base cell can point elsewhere.
state_owner: Static default label workspace
semantic_purpose: Reserve 64 eight-byte cells for each label's target virtual address.
teaching_section: Reference: selected label storage

name: cc-label-vaddr-buffer
interface_notes: Zero denotes an undefined label. Initialization selects the default array; direct selection replaces the base.
state_owner: Workspace selector owns this mutable base pointer
semantic_purpose: Hold the current base address of the label target virtual address column.
teaching_section: Reference: selected label storage

name: cc-label-default-vaddr cc-label-vaddr-buffer !
interface_notes: Selects builder storage; it does not emit a target store, reset label count or fill every array cell.
state_owner: Source-loading initialization selects one default column
semantic_purpose: Install the static default vaddr array address in its selected-base cell.
teaching_section: Reference: selected label storage

name: cc-label-vaddr
interface_notes: Zero denotes an undefined label. Row operations apply cell[] afterward.
state_owner: Clients borrow the currently selected column base
semantic_purpose: Read and return the selected base pointer for the label target virtual address array.
teaching_section: Reference: selected label storage

name: cc-label-default-fixup
interface_notes: Node format depends on legacy versus LP64 goto producer; do not use the wrong walker. The selected-base cell can point elsewhere.
state_owner: Static default label workspace
semantic_purpose: Reserve 64 eight-byte cells for each label's forward-reference list head.
teaching_section: Reference: selected label storage

name: cc-label-fixup-buffer
interface_notes: Node format depends on legacy versus LP64 goto producer; do not use the wrong walker. Initialization selects the default array; direct selection replaces the base.
state_owner: Workspace selector owns this mutable base pointer
semantic_purpose: Hold the current base address of the label forward-reference list head column.
teaching_section: Reference: selected label storage

name: cc-label-default-fixup cc-label-fixup-buffer !
interface_notes: Selects builder storage; it does not emit a target store, reset label count or fill every array cell.
state_owner: Source-loading initialization selects one default column
semantic_purpose: Install the static default fixup array address in its selected-base cell.
teaching_section: Reference: selected label storage

name: cc-label-fixup
interface_notes: Node format depends on legacy versus LP64 goto producer; do not use the wrong walker. Row operations apply cell[] afterward.
state_owner: Clients borrow the currently selected column base
semantic_purpose: Read and return the selected base pointer for the label forward-reference list head array.
teaching_section: Reference: selected label storage

name: cc-label-default-switch-depth
interface_notes: Native adjustment compares source depth from the goto node with this destination depth; it does not encode switch ancestry. The selected-base cell can point elsewhere.
state_owner: Static default label workspace
semantic_purpose: Reserve 64 eight-byte cells for each label's lexical switch depth at definition.
teaching_section: Reference: selected label storage

name: cc-label-switch-depth-buffer
interface_notes: Native adjustment compares source depth from the goto node with this destination depth; it does not encode switch ancestry. Initialization selects the default array; direct selection replaces the base.
state_owner: Workspace selector owns this mutable base pointer
semantic_purpose: Hold the current base address of the label lexical switch depth at definition column.
teaching_section: Reference: selected label storage

name: cc-label-default-switch-depth cc-label-switch-depth-buffer !
interface_notes: Selects builder storage; it does not emit a target store, reset label count or fill every array cell.
state_owner: Source-loading initialization selects one default column
semantic_purpose: Install the static default switch-depth array address in its selected-base cell.
teaching_section: Reference: selected label storage

name: cc-label-switch-depth
interface_notes: Native adjustment compares source depth from the goto node with this destination depth; it does not encode switch ancestry. Row operations apply cell[] afterward.
state_owner: Clients borrow the currently selected column base
semantic_purpose: Read and return the selected base pointer for the label lexical switch depth at definition array.
teaching_section: Reference: selected label storage

name: cc-label-direct-cap
interface_notes: Five 8192-byte columns occupy 40960 bytes; this constant alone does not select native goto semantics.
state_owner: Direct-workspace label capacity
semantic_purpose: Define the optional direct workspace bound of 1024 entries.
teaching_section: Reference: selected label storage

name: cc-label-direct-base
interface_notes: Zero causes allocation via cc-workspace-map with error 171; it is not a generated code address.
state_owner: Direct workspace selector caches its builder mapping
semantic_purpose: Hold the optional 40960-byte mapping base so repeated selection does not map again.
teaching_section: Reference: selected label storage

name: cc-label-default-workspace
interface_notes: Does not reset count, copy rows or free a direct mapping; select before normal active-row initialization.
state_owner: Workspace selector replaces limit and five bases
semantic_purpose: Reinstall capacity 64 and every default array address.
teaching_section: Reference: selected label storage

name: cc-label-direct-workspace
interface_notes: Does not reset count, migrate rows or expand the arena. Each column occupies two 4096-byte pages.
state_owner: Workspace selector owns cached mapping and selected table pointers
semantic_purpose: Lazily map 1024*40 bytes, set limit 1024, and install five column bases at 0,8192,16384,24576,32768 bytes from the mapping.
teaching_section: Reference: selected label storage

name: cc-label-count
interface_notes: A new function resets the count, not every array byte. Labels are independent of block symbol scopes.
state_owner: Function entry resets; label creation advances the visible label prefix
semantic_purpose: Count live rows in the selected label arrays for lookup and finalization.
teaching_section: Labels have a function-wide identity

name: cc-label-vaddr-of
interface_notes: Zero is the unresolved-label sentinel.
state_owner: Caller supplies a valid label ID
semantic_purpose: Index the selected target-address column with cell[] and fetch its value.
teaching_section: Lookup, creation, and definition are different events

name: cc-label-set-vaddr
interface_notes: Creation writes zero; definition writes the current target virtual address.
state_owner: Label creation or definition writes the target column
semantic_purpose: Store a supplied target value in the selected address cell for the ID.
teaching_section: Lookup, creation, and definition are different events

name: cc-label-fixups
interface_notes: Returns a cell address, not the head value; callers fetch, clear or prepend through it.
state_owner: Label row owns its mutable forward-list head
semantic_purpose: Return the address of the selected fixup-head cell for an ID.
teaching_section: Lookup, creation, and definition are different events

name: cc-label-find
interface_notes: Returns an ID or -1; it does not create a row or consult block-local symbol scope.
state_owner: Function-wide active label prefix
semantic_purpose: Pass selected name-address/length columns and count to newest-first cc-name-find.
teaching_section: Lookup, creation, and definition are different events

name: cc-label-create
interface_notes: The capacity check precedes row stores; retained source bytes are required for later lookup.
state_owner: Function label table owns count; selected arrays own row cells
semantic_purpose: Check count+1 against capacity (171), append borrowed name span, zero target/head/depth, increment count and return the new ID.
teaching_section: Lookup, creation, and definition are different events

name: cc-label-find-or-create
interface_notes: Repeated references share one identity; creation and definition remain distinct operations.
state_owner: Function-wide name identity
semantic_purpose: Look up the name and return an existing ID, or append an initialized row if absent.
teaching_section: Lookup, creation, and definition are different events

name: cc-define-label
interface_notes: LP64 leaves pending native nodes for function-end trampolines. Legacy patching neither clears the row head nor frees nodes.
state_owner: This label row owns target address, definition depth and pending head
semantic_purpose: Find/create the row, reject a nonzero prior address (172), store current target/depth, and in legacy patch its pending rel32 fields to here.
teaching_section: Lookup, creation, and definition are different events

name: cc-native-goto-adjust
interface_notes: Entering a deeper depth does not evaluate skipped switch expressions; depth counts do not prove arbitrary switch-ancestry correctness.
state_owner: Goto source and target depths specify target-stack adjustment
semantic_purpose: Emit source-minus-target POP RBX instructions when positive, target-minus-source PUSH RBX when negative, and no adjustment when equal.
teaching_section: Native gotos reconcile source and destination depth

name: cc-native-goto-fixup
interface_notes: Captures the current lexical source depth now; generic 16-byte fixup walkers cannot consume this format.
state_owner: Destination label owns head; goto site contributes field and source depth
semantic_purpose: Prepend a 24-byte {field-offset,source-switch-depth,next} node to the label's forward list.
teaching_section: Native gotos reconcile source and destination depth

name: cc-native-finish-gotos
interface_notes: Providers 117/121 call after the implicit epilogue so normal fall-through returns first. Legacy 114 does not call this finisher. Heads/nodes are not cleared/freed.
state_owner: Native function completion owns trampoline emission; labels retain destinations
semantic_purpose: Walk each label's pending nodes, reject undefined target (174), patch each original field to a new trampoline, adjust depths, jump to label, and follow node+16.
teaching_section: Finish after emitting the ordinary return path

name: cc-parse-goto-stmt
interface_notes: Legacy unconditionally unwinds every current switch save, assumes target outside switches, and has no function-end undefined-label check in 114.
state_owner: Function-wide label identity and profile-specific pending-node owner
semantic_purpose: Require a name (173), find/create its row, emit a known-target branch or record a future field, and require semicolon; LP64 additionally reconciles source/destination depths.
teaching_section: A legacy goto finishes at the label

name: cc-peek-after-is-colon?
interface_notes: True leaves colon consumed. False restores the original pending flag (normally zero); the expression adapter supplies the later putback. Comments are looser than these postconditions.
state_owner: One nonrecursive token peek borrows the shared lexer mark
semantic_purpose: Save the consumed identifier state, read one fresh token, commit a colon, or restore the whole saved state when false.
teaching_section: The identifier fork needs one speculative token

name: cc-parse-expr-stmt
interface_notes: Leaving its value in RDI needs no discard instruction; expression temporaries remain the expression parser's responsibility.
state_owner: Expression parser owns expression temporaries; statement adapter owns terminating semicolon
semantic_purpose: Put the already-read first token back, parse the expression, then require semicolon.
teaching_section: Close the dispatcher without hiding its other clients

name: cc-parse-ident-stmt
interface_notes: LP64 recursively parses the labeled substatement; legacy returns after the label prefix. A currently visible typedef wins before colon lookahead.
state_owner: Dispatcher chooses typedef declaration, label definition or expression owner
semantic_purpose: Check ordinary symbols for typedef first; otherwise save the name span across colon peek, define a label on success, or replay an expression statement on failure.
teaching_section: Typedef first, then colon, then expression

name: cc-parse-stmt
interface_notes: LP64 case/default requires open switch depth and recursively consumes a following statement. Legacy named-label handling can consume only a label prefix.
state_owner: Dispatcher routes the next token; selected parser owns the remaining syntax
semantic_purpose: Collect storage/qualifier state, read the first token, try LP64 label/declaration routes, then empty, legacy declaration, return, control, compound, identifier and expression routes.
teaching_section: Close the dispatcher without hiding its other clients

name: ' cc-parse-stmt is cc-parse-stmt-fwd
interface_notes: Load-time Forth binding, not a C source statement or target instruction.
state_owner: Completed statement dispatcher supplies the deferred implementation
semantic_purpose: Install the execution token of cc-parse-stmt into cc-parse-stmt-fwd after all mutually recursive consumers are defined.
teaching_section: Reference: statement boundaries and recursive branches

name: cc-fn-name-addr
interface_notes: Does not copy bytes; the source buffer must remain valid.
state_owner: Current definition retains its name across parameter/body token reads
semantic_purpose: Store the borrowed source address of the current function name.
teaching_section: Reference: function-name bookkeeping

name: cc-fn-name-len
interface_notes: Allows lookup and main comparison after tok-* has been overwritten.
state_owner: Current definition retains its name across parameter/body token reads
semantic_purpose: Store the byte length paired with cc-fn-name-addr.
teaching_section: Reference: function-name bookkeeping

name: cc-fn-param-count
interface_notes: This is not a stored signature or a six-parameter parser guard; spills cover only the first six.
state_owner: Parameter-list parser resets and increments; spill emitter reads
semantic_purpose: Count successfully claimed named parameters of the current definition.
teaching_section: Reference: function-name bookkeeping

name: cc-fn-prior-sym-id
interface_notes: Only a prior sk-func is walked; lookup after append would find the new empty-head record.
state_owner: Function registration retains the lookup result before appending a newer row
semantic_purpose: Remember the previously visible name ID, or -1, so prior function call/address lists can be completed.

name: cc-main-name-bytes

state_owner: Program startup owns 12 built-in sk-typedef rows
semantic_purpose: Register FILE, the eight signed/unsigned integer-width names, size_t, ssize_t and intptr_t with int/depth-zero encoded payloads.
teaching_section: A recognized external name may still have no body

name: cc-check-fns-defined
interface_notes: Unused unresolved prototypes are permitted. Under LP64 the unresolved name is written before 206; this check does not resolve or validate named goto labels.
state_owner: Program completion owns unresolved-use and required-main checks
semantic_purpose: Scan visible sk-func rows and fail 206 for nonempty call/address heads, then fail 207 when main address is zero.
teaching_section: Reference: unresolved use and missing main are different failures

name: cc-parse-program
interface_notes: Global append/patch and ELF-size completion belong to the outer driver afterward; this word does not select native program producers merely because their source was loaded.
state_owner: One legacy translation-unit compilation owns emission and registration order
semantic_purpose: Emit entry/eager bodies, register late/external/type names, parse user declarations, emit demanded late bodies, reject unresolved uses or missing main, then patch the entry call.
teaching_section: Reference: unresolved use and missing main are different failures

name: cc-out-path
interface_notes: The source requests that path at driver completion; the literal is not evidence a file exists.
state_owner: Static builder output-path object
semantic_purpose: Name the start of the 12 bytes /tmp/cc-out followed by NUL, initialized immediately after create.
teaching_section: Reference: the last file executes, not merely defines

name: cc-out-path byte data
interface_notes: These c, operations initialize builder data; do not confuse them with cc-emit-byte writes into the generated ELF buffer.
state_owner: Static output-path initializer
semantic_purpose: Append the twelve bytes spelling /tmp/cc-out plus a zero terminator.
teaching_section: Reference: the last file executes, not merely defines

name: cc-main
interface_notes: The write result is discarded by cc-write-output; source inspection or a derived cursor does not establish successful file creation or a compiler/bootstrap run.
state_owner: Executing legacy driver owns source ingestion, finalization order and one output attempt
semantic_purpose: Read stdin, preprocess, reset output/globals, emit ELF header/program, finalize globals then ELF sizes, request output at cc-out-path and exit the builder.
teaching_section: The builder begins before the target has an entry point

name: cc-main (top-level invocation)
interface_notes: The actual loader recipe must put the executing file after all intended libraries. Reading this source as text is not running it; Stage-A execution/evidence remains C20.
state_owner: Final source-loading action transfers control to the driver
semantic_purpose: Invoke cc-main unconditionally as this file is loaded; its body reads stdin, compiles, requests output and exits.
teaching_section: Reference: the last file executes, not merely defines
